name: Task_4
description:
Prepare usable force constants for bulk Palladium (Pd). Start from a primitive face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell with a lattice parameter of a = 3.89 \u00c5. The MACE-MP-0 foundation model should be used as the ASE-compatible calculator to describe interatomic interactions. Compute the force constants using a finite-difference method with a 5 \u00d7 5 \u00d7 5 supercell and an accurately chosen displacement, or use analytical derivatives checked against displaced forces.

Use the supplied checkpoint without dispersion, a one-atom primitive cell with vectors (0,a/2,a/2), (a/2,0,a/2), (a/2,a/2,0), and Pd mass 106.42 amu. Apply cubic symmetry, pair symmetry, and the acoustic sum rule, retaining small raw residuals and improving the force calculation if large corrections are needed. Retain the final accurate force calculations and geometry in an NPZ archive.
